CustomPhaseEditor.Adjustments.IntervalEx:
The lower the interval exponent, the greater the impact of "Last Run" on weight
The higher the interval exponent, the smaller the impact of "Last Run" on weight

The lower the lane occupied multiplier, the smaller the impact of lane occupancy on weight
The higher the lane occupied multiplier, the greater the impact of lane occupancy on weight

CustomPhaseEditor.Options.PrioritisePede: When enabled, if traffic participants are waiting on pedestrian lanes in this phase, the phase priority is set to >= 104
CustomPhaseEditor.Options.PrioritisePubl: When enabled, if traffic participants are waiting on public transport lanes in this phase, the phase priority is set to >= 104
CustomPhaseEditor.Options.PrioritiseTrac: When enabled, if traffic participants are waiting on tram tracks in this phase, the phase priority is set to >= 104

CustomPhaseEditor.Statistics.Title: Statistics
CustomPhaseEditor.Statistics.Tooltip: During simulation, a target duration is calculated first. Once the current phase duration reaches that target duration, the phase advances. When advancing phases, the system first chooses the highest-priority phase, then the one with the highest weight
CustomPhaseEditor.Statistics.TrackLaneOc: Occupancy of tram tracks / train tracks

CustomPhaseEditor.Template.Title: Template
CustomPhaseEditor.Template.Tooltip: Save the current phase as a template, and apply an existing template to the current phase
DefaultAlwaysGreenKerbsideTurnDesc: Set all traffic lights without custom configurations to allow turning on red. It applies to newly built roads and will apply to existing roads upon a game state update
DefaultExclusivePedestrianDesc: Add an exclusive pedestrian phase at all traffic lights without custom configurations. It applies to newly built roads and will apply to existing roads upon a game state update
DefaultSplitPhasingDesc: Set all traffic lights without custom configurations to split phasing mode. It applies to newly built roads and will apply to existing roads upon a game state update
ForceAllNodesUpdateDesc: Force all nodes (road junctions) to update, applying the default settings in this mod to all traffic lights without custom configurations. This feature is only available after a city is loaded
ForceAllNodesUpdateWarning: All nodes will be updated. The default settings in this mod will apply to all traffic lights without custom configurations
